## Summary

This PR improves the test suite for `src/validator.js` by adding new test cases that significantly increase mutation-adjusted coverage. No changes were made to `src/ui/` or other restricted directories.

## Metrics

| Metric | Before | After | Change |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Coverage | 100% | 100% | 0% |
| Mutation Score | 6.25% | 93.75% | +87.5% |
| MAC | 6.25 | 93.75 | +87.5 |

## Changed Files

- `test/validator.mac-cov.test.js`
- `test/validator.mac-mut.test.js`

## Verification

- [x] Test suite is green
- [x] Mutation-adjusted coverage improved
- [x] No modifications to `src/ui/`
